notes: West side of the Col d'Aubisque from Laruns (app: start 519 m, 16.7 km, Eaux-Bonnes km 4.0, Gourette km 12.5). km 0 = Rue de Gerp (D934) south of Laruns at the junction with the Vieille Route des Eaux-Bonnes (~518 m DEM), about 0.2 km before the D934/D918 roundabout; this point reproduces the app's length and landmarks (routed 16.65 km; Eaux-Bonnes entry 3.96, Gourette 12.40, DEM 520 m → 1709 m). Laruns centre (Place de la Mairie) is ~0.9 km before it and lower (the road dips to the Gave bridge), so it is not used. Route: D934 to the roundabout, then the D918 'lacets' above Laruns (NE to a hairpin at the Vieille Route junction, back SW to a second hairpin, then east along the Route de Laruns) to Eaux-Bonnes; through Eaux-Bonnes on Rue Louis Barthou (one-way loop round the Jardin Darralde; the parallel Avenue Castellane is the other half), D918 Route de Gourette with the Valentin bridge, Gourette, and the D918 Route du Gabizos to the col. Two older, shorter roads (Route de Castellane and Route d'Assouste, unclassified/tertiary) run parallel within 40-90 m of the D918 between km 2.4 and 3.9; a shortest-path router takes them (~0.5 km shorter) unless forced, so waypoints there carry a small explicit 'radius' (15-20 m). Coordinates are on the Overture/OSM road geometry, km are routed distances from the foot. 'Pont d'Iscoo' and 'Pont de Goua' (app landmarks) are not named in the map data; their km come from the app and are marked medium.
